title: Vitki: öppen plattform för analys av runinskrifter
description: Open research platform for runic inscriptions: automatic 3D groove measurement of recognised runes with uncertainty, provenance and a published list of known limitations; Rundata integration; orthographic stylometry with cross-validated accuracy; a shared measurement corpus; statistical comparison of stones; corpus statistics in R; reports in eleven publication formats; maps, style groups and an RTI (PTM) viewer. See METHODS.md.
